title.th: ตัวอย่างแบบทดสอบปลายหลักสูตร

source: Fictional Cloud Library demonstration; not a workplace training course

prompt.en: In fictional Cloud Library room 1, the practice map assigns book returns to the Willow desk. Which desk should a visitor use for book returns?

explanation.en: The practice map for room 1 names the Willow desk for book returns. This is fictional demonstration content.
